principles: The documented rapid 1950s football growth is pre-federation context; QFA identity begins only in 1960.
FIFA membership (1963) and AFC membership (1967) are separately gated.
FIFA Big Count 2006 is used only from 2006 and its relatively small participation base is kept distinct from later professional/infrastructure strength.
FIFA Professional Football Report 2023 is gated to 2023; QFA's 2024–2030 strategy is a current development/governance signal from 2024.
Hosting, rankings and tournament results are not calibration targets; no dimension exceeds 9.0.
